# PR #480 opposite-family review

**READY** for the bounded stationary-history change at the reviewed child head and base. Formal scan 1 of 3. Reviewer GPT-6.1 Sol, xhigh. Claude Sonnet 5.5, xhigh implemented this UI slice under the accepted GPT architecture.

| Identity | Verified value |
| --- | --- |
| Child head | `c2cffebb7ca1bbea41ae72a37b9f232c90681906` |
| Child tree | `621ceb492fc333aae30b9051e06eed0be31d3461` |
| Effective base and merge base | PR #478, `993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd`, `codex/gg-20261114-canvas` |
| Native recovery source and tree | `8991be35fd50c6ab9a1d5eee51b124b70f0eabc7`, `c76d401f245c1f13a3279f9add51f28c3d66a5f1` |
| Older partial native source and tree | `8215514281fd84bf08839c5ad4875d018ccadd28`, `bc22119cc598efeea804bfb1a6815245c2fa9038` |
| Actual main | `8fadcb0d44ac2caf80ff6279fe4648ce9398afd9` at admission, advanced during review to `41bde22c80a796bf8c4bec8ab5dec8e755271f9e` by the #475 merge. Live #480 head and effective base were unchanged. |

The worktree was clean. The published draft remained open and its live body matched the publication readback. I independently regenerated both Git comparisons from these object IDs. All 994 changed path entries and current blob hashes matched the supplied readback. The 19-path non-QA diff is 119,044 bytes, SHA-256 `58abad6e8d793da890ba3cbddf5713b3c53783085b3ec6edec9934c67efe8ddd`. The full diff is 67,639,172 bytes, SHA-256 `18e34b14d31bed65554933165eac73efc67373d777f38f03dd2b547813f89782`. The only non-QA change between 899 and c2c is the delivery register. Product, tests and build inputs on c2c match 899.

## Findings and dispositions

- **FIX-IN-PR:** none. No confirmed introduced correctness, lifecycle, data-preservation or product interaction blocker in the bounded child diff.
- **DEFER-ISSUE:** none proposed. The R512 initial modal click missed a card whose center was outside the visible canvas. Both the actual first failure and the later Fit View setup are retained. The latter validates a reachable normal control and the modal history sequence without altering the graph. This evidence does not isolate an introduced toolbar or canvas defect. The known duplicate ID, stale selection and node-drag capture findings remain on #478. The separate Space cards interaction is outside this child diff.
- **NO-CHANGE:** retain the explicit evidence limits. The 821 first partial packet lost the validation-failure frame to a filename collision and lacks the immediate post-Publish GET body. 899 captured the current-only response in its own cases. The later reconnect screenshots in the 899 ownership cases show Loading, so the error-state finding rests on the initial settled 404 view and raw frame/AX/request evidence. Physical touch hold, actual browser text zoom, and screen-reader speech remain unwitnessed. The review does not convert those evidence limits into product defects.
- **DUPLICATE-STALE:** none among child findings. The archived prior fixture failures and the canvas raw formatting snapshot are retained historical evidence.

## Acceptance and implementation review

| Criterion | Source and test assessment | Native evidence and limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stable Undo/Redo bounds through width, wrap, save and validation changes | `apps/web/src/editor/EditorToolbar.tsx:95–106` places history first in a nonshrinking, top-aligned fixed-height sibling. Breadcrumb, save state, validation, run links and Publish share the flexible wrapping sibling. Slot order is the actual DOM and focus order. The toolbar tests check both identity and Tab order, never substitute DOM identity for layout measurements. | On 899, measured desktop/fine, desktop/coarse, N768 and R512 windows held both boxes and fixed-point hits through the sampled changes. R512 spans 150→194 CSS px header heights. A 360 px fine guard and the D1 first-paint/held-Publish/1 px detector evidence are from 821. |
| Active presses and one-step history | `UndoRedo.tsx:15–16,40–54` overrides only these ghost buttons' translation and preserves focus, metadata, callback/store routing and disabled guards. Active color changes use the existing border width. Compiled-utility tests exercise the active cascade against the shared ghost rule and qualify jsdom limits. `EditorPage.tsx:148` retains the same keyboard hook, including editable-field exclusions and modal focus behavior. | Upper-row trusted down/up/click reached the same enabled target during held Undo and Redo. Held save/validation responses changed the displayed state during live presses. The retained sequence covers disabled no-write, focus, Ctrl shortcuts, Space, Enter, coarse tap emulation, and inert modal background coordinates. Recovery has 59 recorded conditional writes with exact wire/device/GET graphs and prior tokens. |
| One connection status and unchanged toolbar position during connectivity changes | `App.tsx:34–51`, `connection-banner.ts:16–58`, and `EditorConnectionBanner.tsx:17–23` reuse the shell's status logic and markup. Claim lifetime follows a mounted component, with per-claim idempotent release and a synchronous layout-effect handoff to the shell subscriber. The full app has one mounted main shell. Browser online/offline and reachability selectors, grace, probes and classification are unchanged. | 821 has scoped offline recovery, full transport abort, PUT-only flash and HTTP 500 negative cases. The observed fault states place a single relevant status below the toolbar with fixed targets. HTTP 500 request/status evidence survives the overwritten validation frame. These four fault groups were not rerun on 899. |
| Shell fallback and lifecycle | `EditorPage.tsx:334–375,635–676` makes the claim unreachable on unsupported or unpreserved data, loading/error and absent definition, and omits the claimant while voice staging makes the frame inert. Keyed route/error replacement releases it. Component coverage exercises overlapping claims, repeat release, StrictMode, realistic routes and fetch states, render failure, voice staging rejection, auth, shutdown and storage alongside the status. A native node dialog still supplies its existing background inertness. | 821 captures the actual loading→loaded→other route→re-entry handoff. 899 captures initial settled 404 error on D1 and R512, one shell status, no editor/history toolbar. Each trace includes two initial 404s and a third on reconnect. Voice/auth/storage/shutdown and strict replay retain component/source evidence. |

I read the complete eight production files and five added tests, the five changed behavior/documentation files plus the delivery register, the applicable repo instructions, issue #208 and owner split decision, and the independent-review policy and final gates. I traced the ordinary EditorRoute/bootstrap tree, AppShell, ErrorBoundary, online/reachability subscriptions, visibility branches, voice preview staging cleanup, shared button styling, shortcuts, modal interaction and public loop read/write boundary. The change stays in the UI. No API, dependency, schema, format, persisted-geometry, coverage configuration or CI policy change is in the child diff. The changed QA attributes preserve raw bytes. I verified the historical Markdown→.md.txt rename has the same Git blob and the same 290,091 bytes and SHA-256 `a52e3ff3811ce45be66885d0ac9557167443589e99a634f758c8c994023cc9f9`.

## Evidence actually checked

- **Source and component tests.** I inspected the final source hash manifest/handoff (`635c4c2c…`), focused results and old-source controls, and the 821/899 integration readbacks. Prior source evidence records 591 tests in 50 files and 96 final focused tests in 12 files, with 31 failing old-source regressions plus six passing controls and an A2-only 9/4 pairing. Integration logs show 147/14 on 821 and 191/17 on 899 with focused static checks. No fresh test, build, coverage or browser run was executed in this review.
- **Historical native baseline.** The 46-run, 433-action evidence is measured cause evidence, including the 1 px active-press target loss and loaded toolbar shifts from browser offline or transport. It is scoped to the stacked baseline; the initial quota and fixture failures and the auxiliary text-field typo remain qualified.
- **Native raw records.** I reviewed the two native drivers and their geometry, hit, role, press, network and exact-graph oracles. I independently parsed all 67 recovery frame files (15,563 samples). Across the 57 measured stationary windows, matching raw frames showed no fixed-point misses, box movement or scroll-offset exclusions. No sampled frame showed duplicate visible connection statuses. I cross-checked all 59 accepted conditional PUT wire/device/GET pairs, exact prior tokens and the three documented Script defaults, five actual current-only response bodies, and both initial error-view traces. I checked raw files for the five 821 groups and representative incomplete D1 and ownership cases, and inspected the R512 before/after fixture screenshots. The test tiers show five scoped first groups on 821 plus six remaining groups across eight invocations on 899, without one complete fresh-head matrix.
- **Publication integrity.** I rehashed all 856 entries in the four child packet checksum manifests and all 61 in the updated canvas raw-snapshot packet. All matched, and all 180 local README references resolved across those five packets. I checked retained native binding/domain-link hashes and the explicit duplicate mappings for the before/after proofs, and read the cleanup and fixture-correction records. The 899 recovery binding records 1,505 source/build inputs, 21 directly embedded web modules, the separate emitted-domain chain and 1,227 stable outputs across 13 trees. This review did not recreate native outputs or touch services or stores.

## Remaining delivery gates

Scan 1 applies to the exact c2c/993d child pair above. The earlier review/QA results, native evidence, current exact-target CI, final integration and the fresh independent Astra max sign-off remain distinct. At the live CI read, routing, template image and Windows launcher had succeeded, and Gates and Browser were still in progress. PR #478's corrections and any new integration context must be resolved on the actual main line before final-head integration checks and exact-target approval. #208 owner acceptance and issue closure remain open. No additional scan or publication was initiated in this review.

---

Root disposition: I read the complete report and accept READY for this exact child/head scope. No FIX-IN-PR or DEFER-ISSUE finding was admitted. This uses formal scan 1 of the total three; it is not final merge approval. The current native evidence spans 821 and 899, with its stated limits preserved. Corrected #478 integration, actual-main targeting, refreshed evidence/CI and the designated fresh GPT Astra max whole-PR final sign-off remain open. Owner acceptance remains on #208.

Report SHA-256: `23177277a1341249801c64cff4ad2df5ef0e692f9dd8145ab877a5448fb945d1`.

pr.body:
Part of #208. Owner acceptance and closure stay on that issue. The explicit Space cards action is a separate change in the same approved intent.

Undo and Redo now keep fixed leading positions as history labels, save notices and connectivity change. Their pressed styling preserves the target position. The loaded editor owns one connection-status notice; the shell supplies it on loading, error and other routes, avoiding duplicate announcements and moving toolbar targets.

Claude Sonnet 5.5 xhigh implemented the UI after GPT architecture review. This draft is stacked on #478, whose new canvas findings are being corrected. It cannot merge ahead of that predecessor.

## Candidate and verification

Head `c2cffebb7ca1bbea41ae72a37b9f232c90681906`, tree `621ceb492fc333aae30b9051e06eed0be31d3461`, targets `codex/gg-20261114-canvas` at `993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd`. Tested product source `8991be35fd50c6ab9a1d5eee51b124b70f0eabc7` integrates that canvas source; subsequent `36b244c5` and this head change only evidence and delivery metadata. Product, test and build inputs remain identical. The inherited historical Markdown snapshot was renamed to .md.txt with its original bytes and hash, so the preserved format failure does not itself fail the current formatting gate.

- The baseline measured 46 runs and 433 actions. [Baseline evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c2cffebb7ca1bbea41ae72a37b9f232c90681906/docs/qa/2026-11-14-history-stationarity-baseline/README.md)
- Source verification passed 591 related tests and 96 final focused tests, no-emit types, scoped lint and formatting. Old-source failures and positive controls remain retained. Current-parent integration passed 191 tests across 17 files and static checks. [Source evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c2cffebb7ca1bbea41ae72a37b9f232c90681906/docs/qa/2026-11-14-history-controls-source/README.md)
- The first independent native run on `82155142` passed five scoped connectivity/save groups, then stopped with its wider matrix incomplete after its two allowed fixture corrections. Those failures and evidence limits are preserved. [Original partial run](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c2cffebb7ca1bbea41ae72a37b9f232c90681906/docs/qa/2026-11-14-history-controls-partial-native/README.md)
- A separately authorized GPT Astra xhigh recovery verified the six remaining groups on `8991be35` across eight invocations: 57 stationary-control outcomes, 59 exact graph checks, 67 frames and zero page errors. Its two fixture corrections are exhausted. Full source/build bindings, served bytes and cleanup passed. [Recovery evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c2cffebb7ca1bbea41ae72a37b9f232c90681906/docs/qa/2026-11-15-history-controls-native-recovery/README.md)

The recovery checked 1,505 runtime/build source files, 21 direct web source-map modules, the separate emitted-domain chain and 1,227 outputs across 13 trees before and after. Both required initial ownership error views were observed with real 404 responses and one shell status. Later reconnect screenshots show Loading; the earlier raw requests, frames and accessibility records establish the error-view checks. The five earlier groups were not rerun on `899`, so this is not a complete fresh matrix on that head. Root read the complete reports, inspected screenshots and verified all 866 committed publication blobs.

## Remaining gates

First opposite-family whole-child review by GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh is READY at this exact head/base, with no introduced blocker or follow-up. Root read and accepted the complete report (SHA-256 `23177277a1341249801c64cff4ad2df5ef0e692f9dd8145ab877a5448fb945d1`). One of three total formal scans is used. Current publication CI has passed Windows launcher, template image and routing; Gates/coverage and Browser are still running. Corrected #478 integration, actual-main retargeting, appropriately refreshed native evidence and the designated fresh whole-PR Astra final sign-off remain required within the three-total-scan cap. The separate Space cards double-click defect does not change this PR's scope or waive its gates. No owner instance, store or service was changed.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the merged build and observations on #208:

- Undo/Redo remain easy to find and target while editing, saving and changing connectivity.
- The single connectivity notice and its placement are understandable on desktop and narrow layouts.
- Pressed and disabled controls feel clear without unexpected movement.

Machine-verifiable behavior remains the pipeline's responsibility; this checklist does not replace engineering gates.
